svg.title: William Harvey's Closed-Loop Circulation (De Motu Cordis, 1628)
svg.desc: Edexcel GCSE History diagram of William Harvey's 1628 closed-loop blood circulation: the heart as a mechanical muscular pump driving bright red arterial blood via the aorta to peripheral tissues, returning as dark blue venous blood via veins with one-way Fabricius pocket valves and the vena cava back to the right heart and pulmonary loop, backed by quantitative proof (~540+ lbs/hour).
svg.text: EDEXCEL GCSE HISTORY · RENAISSANCE EXPERIMENTAL PHYSIOLOGY (1628)
William Harvey's Closed-Loop Circulation (De Motu Cordis, 1628)

g.text: PULMONARY LOOP (LUNGS)
AORTA → ARTERIES
VEINS → VENA CAVA ↑
← 1-Way Valves
R. PUMP
L. PUMP
MECHANICAL MUSCULAR PUMP
LIVER (FED BY LOOP)
Does NOT make blood
← PERIPHERAL TISSUES ←
REVOLUTIONARY MODEL · 1628
One Continuous Closed-Loop Circuit
Physician to James I & Charles I, Harvey proved the same
fixed volume of blood circulates endlessly around the body:
• Arterial Outflow: Pumped out from the left heart via
the aorta and arteries to nourish every organ & limb.
• Venous Return: Returns via veins & vena cava to the
right heart, never consumed or remade by the liver.
RENAISSANCE TECH ANALOGY · FIRE PUMP
Heart as a Mechanical Muscular Pump
• Cold-Blooded Vivisection: Observing slower heartbeats
in lizards, frogs & eels let Harvey watch contraction live.
• Mechanical Analogy: Inspired by 17th-century brass
water/fire pumps, he proved the heart contracts like a
pump — and that contraction causes the arterial pulse.
• Zero Septum Pores: Confirmed Vesalius's solid septum.
EXPERIMENTAL PROOF · VEIN VALVES
One-Way Fabricius Pocket Valves
• Harvey's Padua tutor Girolamo Fabricius discovered
pocket valves in veins (1603) without grasping their role.
• Using iron rods on cadavers and forearm tourniquet
experiments on living men, Harvey proved vein valves
let blood flow ONLY toward the heart — pushing blood
backward snaps the pocket valves shut!
PULMONARY TRANSIT PROVEN
Right-to-Left Transit Through the Lungs
Building on Realdo Colombo's pulmonary observations,
Harvey integrated the lungs into one unified double loop:
1. Right Ventricle pumps all returning dark venous
blood into the lungs via the pulmonary artery.
2. Pulmonary Veins return refreshed bright red blood
to the Left Heart to be pumped into the aorta.
VALVE MECHANISM ZOOM · BACKFLOW BLOCKED
Fabricius One-Way Venous Pocket Valves
OPEN ↑
To Heart
SHUT ✕
No Backflow
Proved blood in veins never ebbs outward from the liver;
valves lock tightly whenever pressed away from the heart.
IMPACT & LIMITS · EDEXCEL EVALUATION
Short-Term Resistance vs Long-Term Legacy
• Missing Piece (1661): Without strong microscopes,
Harvey predicted invisible connections; Marcello Malpighi
saw real capillaries in frog lungs in 1661.
• Foundation of Modern Medicine: Essential for IV
injections, blood pressure checks & blood transfusions
(once Landsteiner discovered ABO blood groups in 1901).

svg.text: QUANTITATIVE PROOF: HEART PUMPS ~540+ LBS OF BLOOD PER HOUR — IMPOSSIBLE FOR THE LIVER TO MANUFACTURE FROM FOOD.
Harvey's calculation (~2 oz pumped per beat × ~72 beats/min × 60 min = over 3× a grown man's entire body weight every hour) proved blood MUST recycle!
